subject: Integration: Evidence Sync APIs for GRC Hub - onboarding plan & pen test schedule
messages:
From: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@grcworks.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: GRC Hub integration - evidence sync API / pen test kickoff

Hi Soojin,

Great to meet briefly at the partner summit last week. As discussed, GRC Hub (grcworks) is ready to prototype a two-way evidence sync with Redwood so our joint customers can push SOC2 evidence from Redwood into their control frameworks.

High-level asks from our side:
- API contract for evidence export (format, auth, delta sync)
- Typical retention and evidence metadata fields (who, timestamp, asset id)
- A dry-run where Redwood sends a small set of example evidence for mapping

We also wanted to coordinate a penetration test point-of-contact. Our vendor (PentestOps) will need to exchange scoping docs and an SOW. I attached a draft SOW from PentestOps for reference.

Can you loop in your security/compliance contact and someone from partnerships to align on timelines? We were hoping to start the dry-run the week of Dec 8.

Thanks,
Tom Nguyen
Head of Integrations, GRC Hub
Tom Nguyen | grcworks.io
attachments: PenTest-SOW-v1.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@grcworks.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC Hub integration - evidence sync API / pen test kickoff

Tom —

Thanks, and glad we connected. Looping Priyom (security integrations) and Marcus (partnerships) to own technical and timeline coordination. Quick clarifications before we schedule the dry-run:

1) Scope of evidence: are you expecting all audit artifacts (log exports, access reviews, config snapshots) or a curated subset (SOC2 artifact types: policies, evidence PDFs, test results)?
2) Auth: Redwood can provide a service principal with scoped read-only access, or we can push events via a signed webhook. Do you have a preference?
3) Pen test logistics: we'll need the SOW + scope of targets and proposed test windows. Who at PentestOps will be shepherding the onboarding?

We should aim for an internal sync next week to map fields and agree on a minimal POC payload. Marcus — can you propose a 30-min slot? Priyom — initial ask: can you review the SOW for any red flags (data exfil rules, approved IP ranges, temporary credentials)?

Best,
Soojin Lee
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC Hub integration - evidence sync API / pen test kickoff

Quick internal notes — copying into the thread for visibility.

Soojin/Marcus,

I reviewed the SOW attached by Tom. High-level items we need from PentestOps before we sign off:
- Test methodology (OWASP/OSCP mappings) and whether credentialed tests are requested
- Data handling: confirmation that test artifacts will NOT be archived outside of the agreed workspace and will be deleted within 30 days
- IP allowlist: static egress IPs for agent callbacks or a secure tunnel proposal

For the evidence sync POC: I propose we start with a curated payload (policy PDFs, role-change logs, and a sample of access review exports). I'll prepare an evidence-mapping template to capture field-level mapping (see file name below).

Action items (internal):
- Marcus: coordinate partner calendar & confirm primary POC at GRC Hub
- Soojin: confirm whether Redwood will push or GRC Hub will pull (I slightly prefer push webhooks with HMAC signing)
- Priyom: draft minimal security requirements for pen test and evidence transfer

I'll send the mapping template by EOD.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
attachments: evidence-mapping.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@grcworks.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC Hub integration - evidence sync API / pen test kickoff

Tom / Eva,

Thanks for the SOW and context. From partnerships side, our proposed plan:
1) Onboarding call: Wed Dec 3, 0900 PT — 30 minutes to agree on POC scope and POCs
2) Field mapping dry-run: Dec 8–10 — Redwood will send a sample set (5–10 artifacts) to your sandbox endpoint
3) Pen test window: Dec 15–19 (tentative) pending SOW sign-off — will provide exact time slots once PentestOps confirms

Tom: can you confirm who at PentestOps will coordinate and whether GRC Hub has a sandbox endpoint we can target? Eva — tagging you in case SecureBridge (your compliance tooling) will need to ingest the same evidence or advise on formats.

I'll attach the shared onboarding notes in Drive (link below) and add the Calendly invite once Tom confirms dates.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
attachments: none
From: Eva Martinez <eva.martinez@securebridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@grcworks.io>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Nov 2025 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: GRC Hub integration - evidence sync API / pen test kickoff

Looping in SecureBridge since we will likely consume the same evidence feed for automated control mapping. A couple quick asks from our side:

- Please include an example of an access review export with the following fields: reviewer, review_date, user_list (anonymized IDs ok), result (pass/fail)
- Prefer JSON payloads with an accompanying PDF for human-readable artifacts
- Our sandbox endpoint is https://sandbox.securebridge.com/hooks/grc (mutual TLS preferred)

Tom — PentestOps contact: kate@pentestops.io will be our coordination lead for scoping. She can join the Dec 3 call if helpful.

We'll review Redwood's mapping template when it arrives. Looking forward to the dry-run.

Best,
Eva Martinez
Director Product Security, SecureBridge
attachments: SOC2-collection-checklist.pdf
